title: ze_kage_cs2
description:
Special thanks to MrNekzzy and Ax7ro for their feedback! The map is improved because of you. 

 🗡️FC Ninja Warriors 
 
 My first project in the FC retro game series
 This map is a chase-style map
 Dynamic weather system
 4-5 defense points
 Bouncy fan mechanisms
 A mysterious Easter egg hidden at the spawn point
 

 📌Changelog 
 b4.0 
 
 Fixed the Easter egg script not working
 Fixed some ladder issues that caused players to get stuck
 Added a climbing ladder to the first fan route
 Removed the Heaven's Punishment mechanic
 Removed the extra attack route at the final defense point
